title: Product-total comparison for the actual sheaf-Hom complexes
statement: Let (C,J,R) and (D,J′,R′) be small ringed sites, using module-section universes containing each site and its coefficient universe. Let U be an additive functor between their categories of sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], preserving integer-indexed products, and let h identify U applied to internal sheaf Hom with internal sheaf Hom of U in both variables [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. Then U HomComplex(K,I) is naturally chain-isomorphic to HomComplex(UK,UI) [def-pur-hom-complex]. Its projection at every integer triple p+n=q is U applied to the source product projection followed by precisely h.

source.place: Sections 0A8X and 08J7, Lemma 0A95; componentwise and localization assembly from steps 4–5 of lem-sf-ringed-forget-two-injective-hom.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sf-ringed-hom-complex-comparison] to the actual sheaf-Hom and Hom-complex bifunctors. Supply the product cones and differential equations from [lem-sc-hom-complex-projections]. Its map-projection equation becomes the abstract equation after composing the precomposition and postcomposition homObjMap factors. Thus the abstract theorem gives exactly the stated chain comparison and projection normalization.

theorem sheafHomComplexComparison :
    ∃ chain : Functor.uncurry.obj (homComplexFunctor (R := R)) ⋙
        U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
      ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).op.prod (U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))) ⋙
        Functor.uncurry.obj (homComplexFunctor (R := R')),
      ∀ (K I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R)) ℤ)
        (n p q : ℤ) (hpq : p + n = q),
        (chain.hom.app (op K, I)).f n ≫
            homComplexπ (R := R') ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K)
              ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I) n p q hpq =
          U.map (homComplexπ (R := R) K I n p q hpq) ≫
            h.hom.app (op (K.X p), I.X q)
